title: [Main]-Adjust Cost Creates an Output Value Entry with Entry Type = Variance and Expected Cost = Yes After Reversing a Finished Production Order.
summary: Fixed a bug where reversing a finished production order and reposting output caused Adjust Cost to create variance value entries incorrectly marked as expected cost instead of actual cost, preventing Post Inventory Cost to G/L from completing.
key_points: Variance and Indirect Cost entries with zero invoiced quantity now use Valued Quantity instead when posting actual cost adjustments
New local procedure GetActualCostAdjmtInvoicedQty determines the correct quantity for posting based on entry type
Prevents expected cost flag from being incorrectly set on actual cost adjustments for variance entries
Resolves Post Inventory Cost to G/L failures on standard cost items after production order reopening
Fix applied across W1, APAC, and RU layers with new test coverage
quote: Fixed in codeunit 5895 "Inventory Adjustment" (W1, APAC, RU layers), as suggested in review
